quests.name: Pirates' Treasure
quests.lore: Pirates down the coast from Plymouth robbed the wharf of the gold its fishermen had pooled. James Hookman wants them taught a lesson.

quests.name: Footpads on the Road
quests.lore: Footpads are robbing people outside Binxonia. The Guild Hall pays for every ten put down. Report to the Squiremaster.

quests.name: Wil Ashby
quests.lore: The footpads at Robbers' Rest answer to Wil Ashby, who was a carter on the Pinewatch road before he started robbing it.

quests.name: Mother Sallow
quests.lore: The best pine near Pinewatch grows around Silkfall Hollow, and Bryn Tolley's crew won't go near it. His cutters say a spider the size of a cart lives at the bottom of the nest.

quests.name: Watch Your Step
quests.lore: The western approach has coral snakes in the grass, and Bram is running out of people willing to walk it.

quests.name: Where They Learn It
quests.lore: Three men on foot could not have moved a cart's load. Whatever took the Beggar's flax is bigger than the camp he was robbed by.

quests.name: The Bell-Ringer
quests.lore: A bell that has not rung in Halden's lifetime rang on Tuesday, in a room he sealed thirty-one years ago.

quests.name: Bitter Points
quests.lore: Linnet Birch wants to try coral snake venom on hunting arrows. She needs glands from the coral snakes southeast of Underleaf, and a second opinion on the result.

quests.name: Venison for the Larder
quests.lore: Wanted: twelve cuts of venison for my stall. Deer graze all over Longmeadow Plains around the village. I pay on delivery. (Joseph Spritzer)

quests.name: Lamps Out
quests.lore: Goblins in the Rustpick workings have been stealing the miners' lamps for their oil. Foreman Cobb Harrow can't send a shift down in the dark.

quests.name: Ore Order
quests.lore: Wanted: ten iron ore for the smiths. There's plenty in the Iron Mine northeast of town. You'll find me at the blacksmith stall east of the tavern. (The Mining Trainer)

objectives.text: Bring 10 iron ore to the Mining Trainer in Binxonia

quests.currentStageText: Bring 10 iron ore to the Mining Trainer in Binxonia

quests.name: Wool Wanted
quests.lore: Wanted: ten bundles of wool. The sheep outside town have plenty to spare. You'll need shears, and the Lumberjack Trainer sells them. Bring the wool to my shop in Binxonia. (The Tailor)

quests.name: The Broken Hammers
quests.lore: Hester Bell's tools are turning up in Rustpick with their handles broken. The goblins have a use for the iron and no use for the smith who made it.

quests.name: Boots for the Road
quests.lore: Nessa has promised lined boots to the patrol, but the woodcutters' delivery is late and Bram keeps adding names to the order.

quests.name: Imp Menace
quests.lore: Imps are stealing from the market stall. Help us by defeating them.

quests.name: The Forge on the Fourth Floor
quests.lore: The orcs are forging spearheads deep in their compound. Sergeant Ilsa Varne wants the forge stopped and whatever orders it runs on.

quests.name: Wolves at the Fence
quests.lore: Bram Fen has been walking cooks home because wolves are coming too close to town.

quests.name: Beyond the Point
quests.lore: An orc raiding party near Underleaf has stripped the west patrol's spare equipment. Tobin Reed needs it back before he sends another pair of guards down that road.

quests.name: Holes at the Elbows
quests.lore: Nessa Holt has a bench full of worn coats and no wool left for patches.

quests.name: Rattling Bones
quests.lore: The dead are walking in the Binxonia crypt. Put ten skeletons back down and the chapel will pay. Speak to the Priest in the Binxonia chapel.

quests.name: Pit Props
quests.lore: The new workings in the Underleaf Silver Mine need timber to hold the roof up, and young hill giants in the valley keep scattering Dace Morrow's felling crew.

objectives.text: Bring 15 oak wood to Dace Morrow

quests.currentStageText: Bring 15 oak wood to Dace Morrow

quests.name: The Man in My Coat
quests.lore: The Beggar never saw a face on the road that night. He saw his own coat walk off in one.

quests.name: A Winter's Wool
quests.lore: Tam Ockley has five sheep in the pen with a winter's wool on, and hands that have stopped closing on the shears.

quests.name: Nobody Came Back
quests.lore: Sergeant Ilsa Varne of the Underleaf watch sent two scouts into the orc compound north of the hollow. Neither returned.

quests.name: Orc Raiders
quests.lore: Orcs are raiding out of their compound north of Underleaf. The watch pays for twelve. Report to Sergeant Ilsa Varne by the notice board. (Sergeant Ilsa Varne)

quests.name: Bear Hides for Winter
quests.lore: Wanted: six bear hides before the cold sets in. Bears roam the woods north of Underleaf. Bring them to my burrow near this board. (The Underleaf Tailor)

quests.name: Bear Meat for the Smokehouse
quests.lore: Wanted: ten cuts of bear meat to smoke for the watch's long patrols. Bears roam the woods north of Underleaf. Bring the meat to my bench. (Linnet Birch)

quests.name: Hollis's Casks
quests.lore: Bandits in Longmeadow keep stopping Hollis Crabb's cider cart on the Plymouth road. He wants his casks back and the road made safe for the next load.

quests.name: The Runaways
quests.lore: Somebody left the paddock gate unlatched overnight and three of the Stablemaster's horses bolted. They won't have gone far, and they won't come back on their own either.

quests.name: The Quiet Rows
quests.lore: Bandits have been skimming the north orchard for three weeks, never enough to bring the constable, always enough to notice. Jack Appleseed wants it answered with steel.

quests.name: The Heavy Bow
quests.lore: The Archery Vendor's crossbow stocks never reached Underleaf. The young hill giants in the valley tipped his cart over and carried them off.

quests.name: Someone's Been Digging
quests.lore: Halden Rooke sweeps the crypt step every third day and knows how the door sits. It is not sitting right.

quests.name: Hides Before the Frost
quests.lore: Linnet Birch makes quivers and bow grips for Underleaf's archers, and she has run out of good hide before the cold months.

quests.name: A Jar for Later
quests.lore: Ada wants to put away a jar of berries before the birds get the lot.

quests.name: Something for the Pot
quests.lore: Ada Fen is short of rabbit for the midday stew.

quests.name: Boar on the Menu
quests.lore: Boars are tearing up the ground southwest of town. Ada has a use for them.

quests.name: An Unpaid Toll
quests.lore: Footpads south of Binxonia are charging travelers to use a road they do not own.

quests.name: What Jill Knows
quests.lore: Jill Appleseed doesn't think the bandits taking exactly enough not to be noticed is luck. She thinks it's bookkeeping, and she wants the book.

quests.name: A Cord of Pine
quests.lore: The Lumberjack Trainer's cutters are out past town, and the woodpile behind his yard is down to bark.

quests.name: Highwaymen on the Road
quests.lore: Highwaymen have taken two horses off riders on the Longmeadow roads this month. The stable pays for three of them. Report to Wes Brooke. (Wes Brooke)

quests.name: The Names on the Stones
quests.lore: Halden's ledger and the crypt disagree about how many are buried under the hill. He wants the brass plates off the coffins to settle it.

quests.name: Boar for the Stewpot
quests.lore: The tavern needs eight cuts of boar meat for the stew. Boars root about in the woods southwest of Binxonia. Paid on delivery. (The Innkeeper)

quests.name: Stolen Axes
quests.lore: Goblins from Scrapstack Warren raid Pinewatch Lodge's woodshed at night, and Bryn Tolley's crew is running out of axes.

quests.name: Hides for the Harness
quests.lore: Wanted: ten deer hides to mend harness and saddles. Deer graze all over Longmeadow Plains around the village. Bring them to the stable. (Wes Brooke)

quests.name: Apples for the Press
quests.lore: Wanted: twenty-five red apples for the cider press. Any tree in the Havenheim orchard will do. Bring them to the tavern. (Hollis Crabb)

quests.name: A Road Worth Keeping
quests.lore: Bram has enough people to run a supply patrol at last. Before they leave, he needs the kitchen stocked and the whole route checked.

quests.name: Howler's Den
quests.lore: A wolf pack has dug a den under the woods northwest of Pinewatch Lodge, and it has grown too big for the game around it. Two of Marta Fenwick's hounds are already gone.

quests.name: Bandits in the Orchard
quests.lore: Longmeadow bandits keep helping themselves to our apples on the way past. Twelve of them, and the orchard pays. Report to Jack Appleseed. (Jack Appleseed)

quests.name: Ragtooth
quests.lore: The wolves of Howler's Den follow a big gray wolf the Pinewatch crew call Ragtooth. Marta Fenwick wants him dead.

quests.name: Snakes in the Reeds
quests.lore: Coral snakes in the valley southeast of Underleaf keep biting my cutting crews. Kill ten and the timber gets through. Find me at the Silver Mine. (Dace Morrow)

quests.name: Giants at the Edge
quests.lore: Young hill giants are pushing out of the valley southeast of Underleaf. The watch pays for eight. Report to me by this board. (Sergeant Ilsa Varne, Underleaf watch)

quests.name: Pirates in the Harbor
quests.lore: Pirates are raiding cargo along the coast. The harbor pays for ten of them. See Harbormaster Orla Quayle on the wharf.

quests.name: Word from the North
quests.lore: A dwarf envoy has come down to Binxonia looking for help. His crew came north to reopen an old iron mine and found it taken.

quests.name: Cutthroats in the Hall
quests.lore: The cutthroats in the bandit camp's main hall plan the robberies of my cider carts. I pay for eight of them. Report to me at the tavern. (Hollis Crabb)

quests.name: Brigands in the Camp
quests.lore: The brigands in the bandit camp send the thieves out to our rows. Ten of them, and the Appleseeds pay. Report to Jill Appleseed. (Jill Appleseed)

quests.name: Mother Sedge's Remedy
quests.lore: Copperheads out in the Wastelands have bitten two of Windthorne's reed cutters. Mother Sedge can brew an antivenom, but only from the snakes themselves.

quests.name: Something New in the Woods
quests.lore: Marta Fenwick has hunted around Pinewatch for twenty years. The giant spiders that moved into Silkfall Hollow are new to her, and she wants to know what their bite does.

quests.name: Gullet
quests.lore: Hill giant adolescents wade the shallows east of Windthorne and smash the village's fish traps. The biggest of them, Gullet, leads them there.

quests.name: Outriders
quests.lore: Dune Raider outriders camp across the road from the Ancient Battlefield. Sergeant Bennet Vale wants to know who pays them.

quests.name: Wool for Winter
quests.lore: Wanted: twenty-five bundles of wool, to knit for the pickers before the cold comes. The sheep northeast of the orchard have plenty to spare. You'll need shears. Bring the wool to the orchard. (Jill Appleseed)

quests.name: Silver in the Deep
quests.lore: The tally book led to a silver seam at the bottom of the bandit cave, and to a name Constable Fenn has carried on his list for four years: Cull Marrow.

quests.name: Before the Rounds
quests.lore: Ellis Pike has two deliveries to plan and no idea whether either workshop is open.

quests.name: The Missing Cart
quests.lore: Oswin Carr's supply cart left Binxonia for Pinewatch Lodge and never arrived. Somebody on that road must have seen where it went.

quests.name: Skark
quests.lore: Scrapstack Warren's goblins answer to Skark, who wears a helm hammered out of a stolen cook pot. Bryn Tolley wants the raids stopped for good.

quests.name: Wolves on the Trade Road
quests.lore: Wolves keep turning back the carts that bring supplies up to Greywood Camp. The Greywood Foreman wants the road kept clear.

quests.name: The Oil Thieves
quests.lore: Kobolds creep into Greywood Camp's stores at night and carry the lamp oil off into Hollowmark. The Quartermaster wants it back.

quests.name: Hollowmark
quests.lore: The Greywood Foreman wants back the survey ledger his crew left in Hollowmark when the kobolds drove them out. The trappers on the deep seam have it.

quests.name: Gutterclaw
quests.lore: A kobold chief named Gutterclaw holds Hollowmark's deep seam, and he wears the key to the dwarves' strongroom.

quests.name: Up to the Snow
quests.lore: A second dwarf crew is camped on the Snowline below another mine. The Greywood Foreman sends the player up with news of Hollowmark.

quests.name: Lost Sledges
quests.lore: Kobold trappers have been raiding the supply sledges on their way up to Snowline Camp.

quests.name: Wolves at the Survey Line
quests.lore: Dire wolves have been stalking the Surveyor along the survey line east of Snowline Camp.

quests.name: Lightning in the Mine
quests.lore: Kobold shamans in Frostvein hang storm fetishes on the tunnel walls. The Surveyor wants to know what they are before his crew walks into one.

quests.name: Old Wickjaw
quests.lore: Old Wickjaw, the kobold chief who holds Frostvein, pried the rune seal off the mine's door. The Snowline Warden wants it back.

quests.name: The Road to Coldwater
quests.lore: With both mines back in dwarf hands, the Snowline Warden sends word to the dwarves of Coldwater.

quests.name: The Drying Racks
quests.lore: Dire wolves come down off Frostspire Road at night and raid the fish drying on Coldwater's racks.

lines: The road above Coldwater is quiet.
Tell the Netmender the wolves are dealt with.

lines.text: Take this for your trouble. And go and see the Fisher on the dock. Something has been at his lines, and it isn't wolves.

quests.name: Pirates' Treasure
quests.lore: Pirates down the coast from Plymouth robbed the wharf of the gold its fishermen had pooled. James Hookman wants them taught a lesson.

quests.name: Footpads on the Road
quests.lore: Footpads are robbing people outside Binxonia. The Guild Hall pays for every ten put down. Report to the Squiremaster.

quests.name: Wil Ashby
quests.lore: The footpads at Robbers' Rest answer to Wil Ashby, who was a carter on the Pinewatch road before he started robbing it.

quests.name: Mother Sallow
quests.lore: The best pine near Pinewatch grows around Silkfall Hollow, and Bryn Tolley's crew won't go near it. His cutters say a spider the size of a cart lives at the bottom of the nest.

quests.name: Watch Your Step
quests.lore: The western approach has coral snakes in the grass, and Bram is running out of people willing to walk it.

quests.name: Where They Learn It
quests.lore: Three men on foot could not have moved a cart's load. Whatever took the Beggar's flax is bigger than the camp he was robbed by.

quests.name: The Bell-Ringer
quests.lore: A bell that has not rung in Halden's lifetime rang on Tuesday, in a room he sealed thirty-one years ago.

quests.name: Bitter Points
quests.lore: Linnet Birch wants to try coral snake venom on hunting arrows. She needs glands from the coral snakes southeast of Underleaf, and a second opinion on the result.

quests.name: Venison for the Larder
quests.lore: Wanted: twelve cuts of venison for my stall. Deer graze all over Longmeadow Plains around the village. I pay on delivery. (Joseph Spritzer)

quests.name: Lamps Out
quests.lore: Goblins in the Rustpick workings have been stealing the miners' lamps for their oil. Foreman Cobb Harrow can't send a shift down in the dark.

quests.name: Ore Order
quests.lore: Wanted: ten iron ore for the smiths. There's plenty in the Iron Mine northeast of town. You'll find me at the blacksmith stall east of the tavern. (The Mining Trainer)

objectives.text: Bring 10 iron ore to the Mining Trainer in Binxonia

quests.currentStageText: Bring 10 iron ore to the Mining Trainer in Binxonia

quests.name: Wool Wanted
quests.lore: Wanted: ten bundles of wool. The sheep outside town have plenty to spare. You'll need shears, and the Lumberjack Trainer sells them. Bring the wool to my shop in Binxonia. (The Tailor)

quests.name: The Broken Hammers
quests.lore: Hester Bell's tools are turning up in Rustpick with their handles broken. The goblins have a use for the iron and no use for the smith who made it.

quests.name: Boots for the Road
quests.lore: Nessa has promised lined boots to the patrol, but the woodcutters' delivery is late and Bram keeps adding names to the order.

quests.name: Imp Menace
quests.lore: Imps are stealing from the market stall. Help us by defeating them.

quests.name: The Forge on the Fourth Floor
quests.lore: The orcs are forging spearheads deep in their compound. Sergeant Ilsa Varne wants the forge stopped and whatever orders it runs on.

quests.name: Wolves at the Fence
quests.lore: Bram Fen has been walking cooks home because wolves are coming too close to town.

quests.name: Beyond the Point
quests.lore: An orc raiding party near Underleaf has stripped the west patrol's spare equipment. Tobin Reed needs it back before he sends another pair of guards down that road.

quests.name: Holes at the Elbows
quests.lore: Nessa Holt has a bench full of worn coats and no wool left for patches.

quests.name: Rattling Bones
quests.lore: The dead are walking in the Binxonia crypt. Put ten skeletons back down and the chapel will pay. Speak to the Priest in the Binxonia chapel.

quests.name: Pit Props
quests.lore: The new workings in the Underleaf Silver Mine need timber to hold the roof up, and young hill giants in the valley keep scattering Dace Morrow's felling crew.

objectives.text: Bring 15 oak wood to Dace Morrow

quests.currentStageText: Bring 15 oak wood to Dace Morrow

quests.name: The Man in My Coat
quests.lore: The Beggar never saw a face on the road that night. He saw his own coat walk off in one.

quests.name: A Winter's Wool
quests.lore: Tam Ockley has five sheep in the pen with a winter's wool on, and hands that have stopped closing on the shears.

quests.name: Nobody Came Back
quests.lore: Sergeant Ilsa Varne of the Underleaf watch sent two scouts into the orc compound north of the hollow. Neither returned.

quests.name: Orc Raiders
quests.lore: Orcs are raiding out of their compound north of Underleaf. The watch pays for twelve. Report to Sergeant Ilsa Varne by the notice board. (Sergeant Ilsa Varne)

quests.name: Bear Hides for Winter
quests.lore: Wanted: six bear hides before the cold sets in. Bears roam the woods north of Underleaf. Bring them to my burrow near this board. (The Underleaf Tailor)

quests.name: Bear Meat for the Smokehouse
quests.lore: Wanted: ten cuts of bear meat to smoke for the watch's long patrols. Bears roam the woods north of Underleaf. Bring the meat to my bench. (Linnet Birch)

quests.name: Hollis's Casks
quests.lore: Bandits in Longmeadow keep stopping Hollis Crabb's cider cart on the Plymouth road. He wants his casks back and the road made safe for the next load.

quests.name: The Runaways
quests.lore: Somebody left the paddock gate unlatched overnight and three of the Stablemaster's horses bolted. They won't have gone far, and they won't come back on their own either.

quests.name: The Quiet Rows
quests.lore: Bandits have been skimming the north orchard for three weeks, never enough to bring the constable, always enough to notice. Jack Appleseed wants it answered with steel.

quests.name: The Heavy Bow
quests.lore: The Archery Vendor's crossbow stocks never reached Underleaf. The young hill giants in the valley tipped his cart over and carried them off.

quests.name: Someone's Been Digging
quests.lore: Halden Rooke sweeps the crypt step every third day and knows how the door sits. It is not sitting right.

quests.name: Hides Before the Frost
quests.lore: Linnet Birch makes quivers and bow grips for Underleaf's archers, and she has run out of good hide before the cold months.

quests.name: A Jar for Later
quests.lore: Ada wants to put away a jar of berries before the birds get the lot.

quests.name: Something for the Pot
quests.lore: Ada Fen is short of rabbit for the midday stew.

quests.name: Boar on the Menu
quests.lore: Boars are tearing up the ground southwest of town. Ada has a use for them.

quests.name: An Unpaid Toll
quests.lore: Footpads south of Binxonia are charging travelers to use a road they do not own.

quests.name: What Jill Knows
quests.lore: Jill Appleseed doesn't think the bandits taking exactly enough not to be noticed is luck. She thinks it's bookkeeping, and she wants the book.

quests.name: A Cord of Pine
quests.lore: The Lumberjack Trainer's cutters are out past town, and the woodpile behind his yard is down to bark.

quests.name: Highwaymen on the Road
quests.lore: Highwaymen have taken two horses off riders on the Longmeadow roads this month. The stable pays for three of them. Report to Wes Brooke. (Wes Brooke)

quests.name: The Names on the Stones
quests.lore: Halden's ledger and the crypt disagree about how many are buried under the hill. He wants the brass plates off the coffins to settle it.

quests.name: Boar for the Stewpot
quests.lore: The tavern needs eight cuts of boar meat for the stew. Boars root about in the woods southwest of Binxonia. Paid on delivery. (The Innkeeper)

quests.name: Stolen Axes
quests.lore: Goblins from Scrapstack Warren raid Pinewatch Lodge's woodshed at night, and Bryn Tolley's crew is running out of axes.

quests.name: Hides for the Harness
quests.lore: Wanted: ten deer hides to mend harness and saddles. Deer graze all over Longmeadow Plains around the village. Bring them to the stable. (Wes Brooke)

quests.name: Apples for the Press
quests.lore: Wanted: twenty-five red apples for the cider press. Any tree in the Havenheim orchard will do. Bring them to the tavern. (Hollis Crabb)

quests.name: A Road Worth Keeping
quests.lore: Bram has enough people to run a supply patrol at last. Before they leave, he needs the kitchen stocked and the whole route checked.

quests.name: Howler's Den
quests.lore: A wolf pack has dug a den under the woods northwest of Pinewatch Lodge, and it has grown too big for the game around it. Two of Marta Fenwick's hounds are already gone.

quests.name: Bandits in the Orchard
quests.lore: Longmeadow bandits keep helping themselves to our apples on the way past. Twelve of them, and the orchard pays. Report to Jack Appleseed. (Jack Appleseed)

quests.name: Ragtooth
quests.lore: The wolves of Howler's Den follow a big gray wolf the Pinewatch crew call Ragtooth. Marta Fenwick wants him dead.

quests.name: Snakes in the Reeds
quests.lore: Coral snakes in the valley southeast of Underleaf keep biting my cutting crews. Kill ten and the timber gets through. Find me at the Silver Mine. (Dace Morrow)

quests.name: Giants at the Edge
quests.lore: Young hill giants are pushing out of the valley southeast of Underleaf. The watch pays for eight. Report to me by this board. (Sergeant Ilsa Varne, Underleaf watch)

quests.name: Pirates in the Harbor
quests.lore: Pirates are raiding cargo along the coast. The harbor pays for ten of them. See Harbormaster Orla Quayle on the wharf.

quests.name: Word from the North
quests.lore: A dwarf envoy has come down to Binxonia looking for help. His crew came north to reopen an old iron mine and found it taken.

quests.name: Cutthroats in the Hall
quests.lore: The cutthroats in the bandit camp's main hall plan the robberies of my cider carts. I pay for eight of them. Report to me at the tavern. (Hollis Crabb)

quests.name: Brigands in the Camp
quests.lore: The brigands in the bandit camp send the thieves out to our rows. Ten of them, and the Appleseeds pay. Report to Jill Appleseed. (Jill Appleseed)

quests.name: Mother Sedge's Remedy
quests.lore: Copperheads out in the Wastelands have bitten two of Windthorne's reed cutters. Mother Sedge can brew an antivenom, but only from the snakes themselves.

quests.name: Something New in the Woods
quests.lore: Marta Fenwick has hunted around Pinewatch for twenty years. The giant spiders that moved into Silkfall Hollow are new to her, and she wants to know what their bite does.

quests.name: Gullet
quests.lore: Hill giant adolescents wade the shallows east of Windthorne and smash the village's fish traps. The biggest of them, Gullet, leads them there.

quests.name: Outriders
quests.lore: Dune Raider outriders camp across the road from the Ancient Battlefield. Sergeant Bennet Vale wants to know who pays them.

quests.name: Wool for Winter
quests.lore: Wanted: twenty-five bundles of wool, to knit for the pickers before the cold comes. The sheep northeast of the orchard have plenty to spare. You'll need shears. Bring the wool to the orchard. (Jill Appleseed)

quests.name: Silver in the Deep
quests.lore: The tally book led to a silver seam at the bottom of the bandit cave, and to a name Constable Fenn has carried on his list for four years: Cull Marrow.

quests.name: Before the Rounds
quests.lore: Ellis Pike has two deliveries to plan and no idea whether either workshop is open.

quests.name: The Missing Cart
quests.lore: Oswin Carr's supply cart left Binxonia for Pinewatch Lodge and never arrived. Somebody on that road must have seen where it went.

quests.name: Skark
quests.lore: Scrapstack Warren's goblins answer to Skark, who wears a helm hammered out of a stolen cook pot. Bryn Tolley wants the raids stopped for good.

quests.name: Wolves on the Trade Road
quests.lore: Wolves keep turning back the carts that bring supplies up to Greywood Camp. The Greywood Foreman wants the road kept clear.

quests.name: The Oil Thieves
quests.lore: Kobolds creep into Greywood Camp's stores at night and carry the lamp oil off into Hollowmark. The Quartermaster wants it back.

quests.name: Hollowmark
quests.lore: The Greywood Foreman wants back the survey ledger his crew left in Hollowmark when the kobolds drove them out. The trappers on the deep seam have it.

quests.name: Gutterclaw
quests.lore: A kobold chief named Gutterclaw holds Hollowmark's deep seam, and he wears the key to the dwarves' strongroom.

quests.name: Up to the Snow
quests.lore: A second dwarf crew is camped on the Snowline below another mine. The Greywood Foreman sends the player up with news of Hollowmark.

quests.name: Lost Sledges
quests.lore: Kobold trappers have been raiding the supply sledges on their way up to Snowline Camp.

quests.name: Wolves at the Survey Line
quests.lore: Dire wolves have been stalking the Surveyor along the survey line east of Snowline Camp.

quests.name: Lightning in the Mine
quests.lore: Kobold shamans in Frostvein hang storm fetishes on the tunnel walls. The Surveyor wants to know what they are before his crew walks into one.

quests.name: Old Wickjaw
quests.lore: Old Wickjaw, the kobold chief who holds Frostvein, pried the rune seal off the mine's door. The Snowline Warden wants it back.

quests.name: The Road to Coldwater
quests.lore: With both mines back in dwarf hands, the Snowline Warden sends word to the dwarves of Coldwater.

quests.name: The Drying Racks
quests.lore: Dire wolves come down off Frostspire Road at night and raid the fish drying on Coldwater's racks.

quests.name: Stolen Lines
quests.lore: Kobold trappers have been stealing fishing line from the Coldwater sheds and cutting it up for snares.
